name: official-registry/com-cosmicjs-mcp
title: Cosmic
description: Manage Cosmic CMS content, media, object types, and AI generation from any MCP client.

headers.description: Bearer <read_key> for reads, or Bearer <read_key>:<write_key> to allow writes
headers.name: Authorization

bucket_slug.description: Slug of the Cosmic bucket to operate on

environmentVariables.description: Slug of the Cosmic bucket to operate on
environmentVariables.name: COSMIC_BUCKET_SLUG

environmentVariables.description: Bucket read key. Enables the read-only tools
environmentVariables.name: COSMIC_READ_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Bucket write key. Required for create, update, delete, and AI generation
environmentVariables.name: COSMIC_WRITE_KEY

authHint.hint: Bearer <read_key> for reads, or Bearer <read_key>:<write_key> to allow writes
